subject: Post-call: HealthcareCo deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) - SOC2/BAA questions
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@healthcareco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps — deployment options and compliance items

Hi Sarah —

Great to speak earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:  

Summary of needs you called out:
- PHI in scope for PII redaction workflows (HIPAA-bound).
- Legal needs a standard BAA and SOC 2 Type II evidence for procurement.
- Procurement asks about deployment options: Hosted API vs Dedicated reserved capacity vs Private (VPC/on-prem).
- Audit window: HealthcareCo expects vendor evidence for the last 12 months and an annual audit process.

What we recommend based on the call:  
- Short term (fastest): Hosted API with BAA and scoped SOC2 artifacts. This allows you to move quickly while we scope controls and data flow.
- Medium term (predictable throughput & isolation): Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) — appropriate if you need stronger isolation and predictable latency without a full private control plane.
- Long term (maximum control/compliance): Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) — required if your security/compliance team requires customer-managed networking or air-gapped options.

Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (redacted SOC 2 Type II report), BAA_Template_Redwood_v1.docx, and a short one-pager on deployment options.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll drop the SOC2 & BAA template into the thread (attached).
2) If HealthcareCo wants to proceed with Hosted API + BAA, legal can review the BAA template; I can loop in our legal ops to fast-track.
3) If you need Dedicated or Private, we should schedule a 60-minute technical workshop with our infra engineering team and your security team (recommend Laura attend).

Can you confirm which path Procurement prefers for budgeting (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) and whether you want us to schedule the technical workshop?

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0162

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (PDF, redacted), BAA_Template_Redwood_v1.docx (DOCX), deployment-options-one-pager.pdf (PDF)
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@healthcareco.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Torres <mike.torres@techops.health>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps — deployment options and compliance items

Thanks Aditya — good summary. A few clarifying items from our side:  

1) BAA: Legal will want to see Redwood sign a Business Associate Agreement. Please confirm your willingness to sign and whether the BAA is editable.
2) SOC2: We need the SOC 2 Type II report and the associated auditor letter for the last 12 months. Is the attached PDF the full report or a redacted summary? Procurement requires auditor name and dates.
3) Deployment preference: our security team strongly prefers Dedicated capacity over multi-tenant hosted API for any PHI workloads. Private is on the table but will require internal approval (longer timeline). For budgeting right now, please provide a baseline monthly cost estimate for Dedicated reserved capacity (N GPUs, example 8x A100 equivalent) and any uplift for a HIPAA-compliant configuration (e.g., dedicated network egress controls, KMS integration).

4) Audit & evidence: our compliance team runs quarterly internal audits and will require access to audit logs and at-rest encryption details. Can you confirm log retention windows and whether logs can be exported for our auditors?

If you can answer the above and share a ballpark Dedicated pricing sheet, we can get Procurement and Security to confirm next week. Also, please loop in your solutions engineer for the technical workshop.

—Sarah
Sarah Nguyen
Director, Technical Compliance
HealthcareCo
sarah.nguyen@healthcareco.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@healthcareco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Mike Torres <mike.torres@techops.health>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps — deployment options and compliance items

Thanks Sarah — answers inline below (and I’ve attached the full SOC2 packet we can share under an NDA).

1) BAA: We are willing to sign a BAA. The attached BAA_Template_Redwood_v1.docx is editable; our legal ops will review edits but we typically accept customer redlines on standard sections. I’ll introduce our legal ops contact if you want to start redlines.

2) SOC2: The PDF in this thread is a redacted public copy. We can share the full SOC 2 Type II report and the independent auditor letter under an NDA. Auditor: Parker & Sutton LLP; Reporting period: 2024-01-01 — 2024-12-31.

3) Dedicated pricing (ballpark):
- Small reserved pool (4x A100-equivalent): $45,000/mo
- Medium (8x A100-equivalent): $82,000/mo
- Large (16x): $150,000/mo
Uplift for HIPAA-config (network isolation, KMS integration, additional logging export hooks): ~15–25% depending on required customizations. Exact pricing depends on peak throughput and retention of audit logs.

4) Audit & evidence:
- Log retention: by default we retain control-plane logs for 90 days and can extend to customer-configured retention (up to 3 years) with an add-on.
- Logs export: yes — logs can be exported to your SIEM (S3, BigQuery, or Splunk) on a scheduled or streaming basis.
- At-rest encryption: customer keys via KMS supported (AWS KMS, GCP KMS), HSM integrations available for Private deployments.

Next steps I suggest:
A) If Procurement is okay with the Dedicated baseline, we can send a draft SOW and estimated quote this week.
B) Schedule a 60-min technical workshop (Laura + our infra eng + Mike?); Laura — can you propose 2 slots for Tue/Wed next week?
C) I’ll send the NDA link if you want the full SOC2 bundle shared.

Thanks — I’ll loop our solutions engineer once you confirm the workshop.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah / team —

Happy to run the technical workshop. Suggested agenda (60 minutes):
- 10m: Introductions + scope (PHI workflows & audit cadence)
- 20m: Architecture deep-dive (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private — network, KMS, log flows)
- 15m: Controls & evidence (SOC2 artifacts, log export mechanics, retention)
- 10m: Migration/rollout plan & timeline (POC -> pilot -> production)
- 5m: Q&A / next steps

Proposed slots: Tue 2026-02-17 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 2026-02-18 14:00–15:00 PT. Please confirm which works (or propose two alternate windows).

Action items I will take once slot is confirmed:
- Bring our infra solutions engineer (Priya) and a controls/ops SME to cover SOC2/BAA questions.
- Prepare a short SOW template and Dedicated pricing worksheet tailored to HealthcareCo throughput estimate (you gave ~120M tokens/month as a reference).

Laura Bennett
